task: Publish the Starlight Constellation protocol, provenance, graph, packaging, and download ledger on starlightintelligence.org.
surface: Responsive static Next.js route at /constellation with nine public manifests and fifty visual receipt rows.
audience: Agent builders, operators, protocol adopters, reviewers, and marketplace integrators who need artifact truth before installation.
first_read: Fifty named agents are available as an inspectable public projection; every manifest state and authority boundary is explicit.

keep: Human authority and private-memory exclusions in the first viewport
One canon projected into three domain-specific jobs
avoid: Marketplace availability without entitlement and commercial terms
Structural eval described as live model quality
Decorative constellation nodes or fake terminal spectacle
Private memory, local paths, credentials, or runtime leases
direction.signature: An evidence observatory where every agent portrait resolves into card, prompt, eval, visual, graph, and packaging receipts.
system: Fraunces, Inter, and JetBrains Mono through next/font
Basalt, paper ivory, protocol violet, cognition cyan, authority amber
One-pixel ledger rules and restrained evidence grid
No client runtime, WebGL, sound, or scroll choreography
Tier-B portraits with Tier-C exact protocol UI

asset_quality.why_premium: All fifty owned portraits were individually inspected and re-hashed before publication, while every public label, state, and digest is rendered in exact HTML/CSS.

artifacts.notes: Desktop 1440x900 and mobile 390x844 first viewports inspected in the in-app browser.
Generated 10-house / 50-agent protocol projection with packaging ledger, trust chain, receipts, and public/private truth contract.
All fifty WebPs loaded successfully after visiting every house; no failed or pending image remained.
Byte and SHA-256 receipts verify the public portfolio, visual provenance, and capability manifest.
Validated source-pack index links the agent, skill, team, plugin, and marketplace layers without claiming runtime admission.
Static evidence-observatory scene brief; no unearned motion or speculative runtime claim.

score.notes: First read 5; protocol/brand fit 5; craft 5; accessibility/responsiveness 5; provenance accuracy 5; intended-surface usefulness 4. One point remains reserved for independent cross-provider visual critique.

known_risks: The capability and skill manifests are descriptive and do not grant tools.
The plugin is a validated local marketplace source, but installation, runtime admission, and a fresh task remain explicit user/runtime actions.
Live model evaluation and runtime admission have not run.
A Vercel preview must still be verified before production promotion.
